scientific_integrity: The affine-map obstruction and explicit suffix contradiction are proved symbolically. The finite ternary census is implemented exhaustively by two independent graph/rank tests. No numerical search is presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The signed-order graph test is necessary, not sufficient; the seven-letter minimum pertains only to this obstruction on words using all three letters. The lower density bound is not claimed sharp. Publication priority beyond searched literature is unverified.
title: A sharp ternary signed-swap obstruction for two-state probabilistic automata
